title: Capability registry
description: Capabilities (runtimes, CLIs, browsers, MCP servers, generators, skills, libraries, services) with an honest availability status. Accepts either the curated registry (references/capability-registry.json: an array of entries) or the output of scripts/environment-audit.mjs (an object with entries[] plus platform, skills, project and notes).

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the audit run.

skills.description: Installed skills found on disk (list of skill records or a map keyed by skill root).

project.description: Project profile from package.json and lockfiles, or null when no project was audited.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. cli:ffmpeg or mcp:higgsfield.

auth.description: Authentication needed (none, api-key, oauth, ...). Never the credential itself.

environment.description: Where the capability exists (main session, subagent, local CLI, project dependency, ...).

cost.description: free, paid credits, metered API, unknown ... Any non-free cost implies requires-approval before use.

network.description: Network use: none, local, external (sends data to a third party), or a boolean.

fallback.description: What to do when the capability is unavailable or not approved.

evidence.description: How the status was established (command + result, probe, documentation). Required: no status without evidence.

verifiedOn.description: Date the status was last verified (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when never verified.
